title: Overgrown
intro: The road is back, and so is the shrubbery. A bush ahead is not the same as a wall ahead: one can be cut, the other can only be turned away from.
cs_note: [b]Case analysis[/b]: path, bush, or wall. List every situation your inputs can produce and make sure each one has an action. Testing on several maps is how you find the case you forgot.
hints: Your 2-3 program treats a bush like a wall and turns around.
Add one more case between "path ahead" and "path to the left": a bush ahead gets cut.

It's the Winding Road program with one more if … else in the chain: path ahead, move; else bush ahead, cut; else path to the left, turn left; else turn right. Order matters: check for a bush before deciding to turn, or the robot turns away from a bush it could have cut.
